lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill area; spacing between centroids is relatively uniform in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition along their horizontal axes.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermiculated pattern of light-intensity lines is present in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion, contrasting with the more regular grid-like pattern further posterior.
